name: Bella Miller
description: Connected through Cross Current, the New Testament Church youth group in Massena that JD attended occasionally from late 2016. He was getting closer to her through mid-2017 and took a Cape Cod trip with the group in August 2017 — the same summer the Bronwyn situation was developing.
bio: JD and Bella became good friends starting around May 2017, bonding over both having Mexican moms. On February 25, 2018 at Cross Current youth in Messina, JD smacked her in the face — thinking he was being funny. It went completely wrong. CFC removed him from youth group as a result. Bella went on to marry Caden Colbert. JD filmed their wedding video in June 2021. They're on good terms.
